title: SeatSure: Event Ticket Booking
context: Concert and train bookings must prevent double-selling a seat across overlapping segments, under heavy demand.
input: Bookings [from, to) on segments; group sizes; price tiers.

milestones.title: Fill a row exactly
milestones.requirement: List distinct groups of bookings that exactly fill a 10-seat row (backtracking).

milestones.title: Segment occupancy
milestones.requirement: Rebuild occupancy from bookings with a difference array.

milestones.title: Price tier
milestones.requirement: Tier for a seat row with a lower bound on tier boundaries.
